trigger.description: An inbound daemon frame fails to decode because the JSON body is malformed, the length prefix exceeds DAEMON_REQUEST_MAX_BYTES (4 MiB), required fields are missing, or the socket is read short. handle_connection returns a structured error envelope with request_id `<unknown>` so the client sees a real frame rather than a connection reset.
trigger.invocation: Send a 4-byte length prefix followed by a truncated or non-JSON body to the UDS socket
